title: Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

reading.body:
A retired couple lost $800,000 in a cryptocurrency investment scam that deployed an AI-generated fake website. The scammer initiated contact through WhatsApp and gradually built the victim's trust by allowing small withdrawals from a fraudulent trading app. The site showed false account balances on what appeared to be a legitimate platform, masking that all invested funds were gone.

This is a case of an AI system used to create a deceptive interface rather than a failure in how a deployed AI system makes decisions. The fake website was the tool of the fraud, not a system that independently failed at its intended task. What would have prevented this loss was human verification of the trading platform's legitimacy before any money changed hands, and skepticism about investment opportunities from unsolicited contacts.

It is not established whether law enforcement has recovered any funds or identified the scammer.

reports.title: Georgia couple loses $800K in sophisticated cryptocurrency scam
Gwinnett couple warn others after losing $800K in cryptocurrency scam

summary:
A retired Georgia couple lost nearly $800,000 in a cryptocurrency scam that started with a WhatsApp message from a stranger. The scammer convinced Jerry Dunaway to invest through a mobile trading app, and initial small withdrawals built his confidence. However, the entire scheme was fraudulent, using an AI-generated fake website that showed false account balances on a legitimate-looking platform. When Dunaway tried to withdraw a larger sum, he discovered the money was gone and contacted police.

The couple, Jerry and Mindy Dunaway, are now speaking publicly to warn others about the sophisticated tactics scammers employ. While they are working with Gwinnett County police, investigators indicate that victims in similar cases rarely recover their funds. The Dunaways' children have created a GoFundMe page to help their parents with daily expenses as they work to rebuild their lives financially.
